outcome: Social identity as a first-time mother
cohort: The study included first-time mothers over 18 years old living in the UK who had given birth within the past nine months.
finding: Having a traumatic birth was associated with lower psychological wellbeing, and the strength of first-time mother identity did not appear to moderate this relationship.
mod_finding: Giving birth by caesarean section independently reduced the strength of a first-time mother's identity.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from participants within nine months postpartum.
